Name: Main Controller (ESP32-S3)
Description: ESP32-S3 development board with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE, and USB-C for power and programming. Handles sound processing and LED control.

Name: Circular Clock Display (1.28 inch)
Product Name: 1.28 inch Round LCD Display Module GC9A01
Description: Round TFT LCD display for eye animations and interactive visual feedback. (Assuming 1.28 inch as a practical interpretation of '17inch' for a desk robot).

Name: Rectangular Dashboard Display (4.3 inch)
Product Name: 4.3 inch SPI TFT LCD Display ILI9488

Name: Main Rotary Encoder with Push Button
Description: Rotary encoder with integrated push button for scrolling and selection.

Name: Back / Home Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input.

Name: Snooze Reminder Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input.

Name: Dismiss Reminder Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input.

Name: Start/Pause Focus Mode Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input.

Name: Mute/Privacy Button
Description: Small tactile button for user input.

Name: USB-C Power Input Connector
Description: USB-C connector for primary power input.

Name: I2S Audio DAC
Product Name: MAX98357A I2S Class D Mono Amplifier
Description: Small Class D amplifier for driving a full-range speaker from the brain's I2S output.

Name: Small Speaker (1W)
Description: Small speaker for audio output.

Name: Microphone Module with I2S
Description: Digital I2S MEMS microphone for high-quality audio capture with low power consumption.

Name: Microphone Physical Mute Switch
Description: Slide switch for overall device power control.

Name: Main Enclosure Bottom Shell
Description: Custom 3D-printed bottom shell forming the base and structural support for internal components. Features internal mounts and cable routing channels.

Name: Main Enclosure Top Shell
Description: Custom 3D-printed top shell with integrated openings for screens, rotary ring, and button cutouts. Designed for a sleek, curved, premium aesthetic.

Name: Circular Display Bezel
Description: Custom 3D-printed bezel for the circular display, designed to smoothly integrate with the rotary ring and main enclosure, providing a clean edge.

Name: Rectangular Display Bezel
Description: Custom 3D-printed bezel for the rectangular display, ensuring a flush and seamless integration into the top enclosure.

Name: Rotary Ring Outer
Description: Outer portion of the custom rotary ring mechanism, designed to be visually appealing and tactile, with internal gearing for the encoder.

Name: Rotary Ring Inner Gear
Description: Inner gear component of the rotary ring, mating with the rotary encoder's shaft, allowing smooth rotation and precise input.

Name: MCU Mounting Plate
Description: Small mounting plate to securely hold the ESP32-S3 main controller within the enclosure, ensuring stability and preventing movement.

Name: Back/Home Button Cap
Description: Ergonomic button cap designed to fit flush with the enclosure surface, providing a satisfying click for the 'Back / Home' function.

Name: Snooze Button Cap
Description: Flush-mounted button cap for the 'Snooze reminder' function, matching the minimalist aesthetic of the device.

Name: Dismiss Button Cap
Description: Flush-mounted button cap for the 'Dismiss reminder' function, maintaining the device's sleek profile.

Name: Focus Toggle Button Cap
Description: Flush-mounted button cap for the 'Start/Pause focus mode' function, designed for a consistent user experience.

Name: Mute/Privacy Button Cap
Description: Flush-mounted button cap for the optional 'Mute/Privacy' function, clearly identifiable if implemented.

Name: Speaker Grille
Description: Custom 3D-printed grille for the small speaker, integrated into the enclosure with a fine mesh pattern for sound diffusion and aesthetics.

Name: Microphone Mount
Description: Small internal mount for the microphone module, positioned to capture sound effectively while being hidden from view.

Name: Microphone Mute Switch Housing
Description: Internal housing for the microphone physical mute switch, allowing it to be securely mounted and accessible from the outside if needed.

Name: USB-C Port Mount
Description: Small internal mount to secure the USB-C power input connector, ensuring stability when plugging/unplugging the cable.

Name: M3x6mm Plastic Standoff
Description: Plastic standoffs used to elevate PCBs (like the main MCU and display drivers) from the enclosure base, preventing short circuits.

Name: M3x6mm Philips Head Screw
Description: Used for securing PCBs to standoffs and fastening internal 3D-printed mounts.

Name: M2x4mm Philips Head Screw
Description: Smaller screws for securing displays to their bezels or mounting small modules like the microphone.

Name: Non-Slip Rubber Feet
Description: Small self-adhesive rubber feet to prevent the device from sliding on a desk surface.

Name: Miniature Ball Bearing (Rotary Ring)
Description: Small ball bearing to provide smooth, low-friction rotation for the outer rotary ring, enhancing the premium feel.

Name: Internal Cable Clips
Description: Small 3D-printed clips integrated into the bottom enclosure to manage and route internal wiring for a clean setup.

Name: I2S Audio DAC Mount
Description: Adapter plate for the I2S Audio DAC that bolts to the main chassis with M3 hardware. Includes wire-routing channels.

Name: Apple MagSafe Charger
Description: Official Apple MagSafe Charger for iPhone wireless charging. Requires separate USB-C power adapter (not included in this project's scope).

Name: MagSafe Charger Mount
Description: Custom 3D-printed mount designed to securely hold the Apple MagSafe charger flush with the enclosure surface.
